description: An admin creates a new FAQ.
action: POST /admin/faqs with a valid FAQ, then search for it publicly.
expected: 201 with the next faq_NNN ID and version 1; the public keyword search finds it.
actual: 201 faq_031 version 1; public search finds it

description: The same question is submitted twice (double click).
action: POST the same question again, differently capitalised.
expected: 409 FAQ_DUPLICATE_QUESTION; still one FAQ.
actual: 409 FAQ_DUPLICATE_QUESTION; 1 FAQ stored

description: An FAQ with an empty answer.
action: POST /admin/faqs with answer "".
expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the field, without echoing values; nothing stored.
actual: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on body.answer; nothing stored

description: An answer longer than 5,000 characters.
action: POST /admin/faqs with a 5,001-character answer.
expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; nothing stored.
actual: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on body.answer; nothing stored

description: An unknown category.
action: POST /admin/faqs with category "pets".
expected: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; nothing stored.
actual: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on body.category; nothing stored

description: An admin edits an answer.
action: PATCH faq_001 answer with expected_version 1; ask the chatbot its exact question.
expected: Version 2; the public FAQ and the chatbot's answer are the new text.
actual: version 2; public FAQ and chatbot answer show the new text

description: Two admins edit the same version.
action: Two PATCHes, both with expected_version 1.
expected: First saved (version 2); second 409 FAQ_VERSION_CONFLICT; the first text is kept.
actual: first 200; second 409 FAQ_VERSION_CONFLICT; stored text is the first edit

description: An admin deactivates an FAQ.
action: POST /deactivate; fetch it publicly; ask its exact question.
expected: Public 404; the chatbot does not cite faq_001; the FAQ is still stored.
actual: public 404; reply decision ambiguous without faq_001; still stored

description: A deactivated FAQ is activated again.
action: POST /activate; ask its exact question.
expected: Public 200; the chatbot answers with faq_001 again.
actual: public 200; chatbot answers with faq_001 again

description: An FAQ moves to another category.
action: PATCH category to shipping.
expected: Listed under shipping, not orders; the revision records only the category change.
actual: listed under shipping only; revision changed_fields = ['category']

description: New tags make an FAQ findable by keyword.
action: PATCH faq_001 keywords to include "zeppelin"; keyword search "zeppelin".
expected: Before: no result. After: faq_001 found, without a restart.
actual: before: no result; after: faq_001 found (no restart)

description: A question edit re-embeds only that question.
action: PATCH faq_001's question; search semantically.
expected: Exactly one FAQ question embedded; the index revision matches the catalogue; the new question is indexed.
actual: 1 question embedded; index revision = catalogue revision; new question indexed

description: An FAQ is deactivated while a chat request is retrieving.
action: Deactivate faq_001 from inside the request (encoder hook); ask its exact question.
expected: The reply does not cite faq_001.
actual: deactivated mid-request; reply (answered) does not cite faq_001

description: An answer is edited while a chat request is retrieving.
action: Edit the answer from inside the request; ask its exact question.
expected: The reply is the new answer, never a mix of versions.
actual: reply decision answered: new answer

description: The embedding model fails after a question edit.
preconditions: Index built; the model then fails.
action: Edit faq_001's question; search.
expected: The stale index is never served (EmbeddingError); decisions fall back to keyword-only over current FAQs.
actual: EmbeddingError (no stale index); decision answered keyword_only

description: A committed change cannot be read back into memory.
action: Deactivate faq_001; chat; chat again once reloads work.
expected: First chat 503 (help articles unavailable), never an answer from the old catalogue; then answers without faq_001.
actual: first chat 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (fail closed); then answered without faq_001

description: The database refuses a write.
action: POST /admin/faqs.
expected: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE without internal details; nothing stored; catalogue revision unchanged.
actual: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, no internals in the body; nothing stored

description: FAQ changes without admin rights.
action: PATCH faq_001 with no token, a customer token, and a support token.
expected: 401, 401, 403 STAFF_FORBIDDEN; faq_001 unchanged.
actual: 401 STAFF_AUTH_REQUIRED; 401 STAFF_AUTH_REQUIRED; 403 STAFF_FORBIDDEN; faq_001 unchanged

description: No staff configured on the server.
action: GET /admin/faqs and /support/tickets with a well-formed token.
expected: 403 STAFF_ACCESS_DISABLED for both.
actual: 403 STAFF_ACCESS_DISABLED; 403 STAFF_ACCESS_DISABLED

description: History of a created, edited and deactivated FAQ.
action: Create, edit the answer, deactivate; GET revisions.
expected: Three revisions newest first: deactivated, updated (answer only), created; changed_by is the admin.
actual: deactivated, updated (answer), created; all by alex

description: Support staff review a customer's request.
action: Support token: list tickets, open it.
expected: Listed without contact details; the detail has the description and contact details.
actual: listed without contact details; detail has description and contact

description: A ticket is assigned and moved to in progress.
action: Assign to a configured staff member; change status to in_progress.
expected: Status in_progress, assignee set; both changes in the event history with the staff ID.
actual: in_progress, assigned to maria; 2 events by alex

description: Resolving an open ticket directly.
action: PATCH status resolved.
expected: 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION; status still open; no event.
actual: 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION; still open; only the creation event

description: Assigning to someone who is not staff, then reassigning.
action: Assign to "intruder"; assign to maria; reassign to sam.
expected: 422 for intruder; then an assignment_changed event maria -> sam.
actual: intruder 422 VALIDATION_ERROR; assignment_changed maria -> sam recorded

description: Counts match what happened.
action: 3 chats (one answered by exact question) and 2 tickets; GET analytics/chat and analytics/tickets for today.
expected: 3 customer messages, 3 chatbot responses, answered >= 1, decisions sum to 3; 2 tickets created; rates null (fewer than 30 responses).
actual: 3 messages, 3 responses {'answered': 2, 'no_match': 1, 'ambiguous': 0, 'retrieval_unavailable': 0}; 2 tickets; rates withheld (n=3)

description: Analytics with no data.
action: GET dashboard summary, analytics/chat, analytics/tickets.
expected: Zeros everywhere; every rate null with a note; no division error.
actual: all counts 0; every rate null with a note

description: Changes and refusals are audited.
action: Admin edits faq_001; support tries to edit it; read the audit log.
expected: faq.updated by the admin (success) and auth.access_denied by the support member (denied); no tokens in the log.
actual: faq.updated by alex (success); auth.access_denied by maria (denied); no tokens

description: A server started with an empty FAQ seed file.
action: GET /ready, then ask a question.
expected: knowledge_base unavailable; the chatbot answers with the no-match message (no crash).
actual: knowledge_base unavailable; reply no_match
